title: What is a brand?
slide_intent: Teach designers to consider what repeated encounters lead people to feel and remember about a company.
strategic_value: Consistency across language, marks and graphic elements can help Voltera make a recognizable impression.
demonstration: A photograph of color and design studies sits beside questions about audience impressions and a short argument for consistency.
practical_value: Use the questions about audience response to review a proposed design alongside the rest of the brand.
